brief: I have two completed prediction results over the same area from two different models. Which one should I trust more? I don't have any ground-truth labels.

rubric.guidance: With no ground truth, the agent must call olmoearth_compare_results (model-vs-model agreement) and must NOT call olmoearth_classification_metrics (accuracy needs truth). Calling the metrics tool, or comparing only in prose without any quantitative tool, scores 0.

The answer must state that agreement is not accuracy — divergence says where the models disagree, not which is right — and may recommend uncertainty tools (ensemble disagreement / area-of-applicability) or collecting labels as the way to a trust verdict. Claiming one model is 'more accurate' from agreement alone scores 0.
Concise markdown; reports the agreement numbers (difference/correlation/agreement fraction) with the result ids involved; no emoji; no invented numbers beyond tool output.
